name: soft-door-box
task: Open the door, then, if possible, pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Open the door' is a commanded step whose later step is only preferred (a soft Existence forces nothing), so the hard Existence(door_open) is required and not redundant; 'then' stays hard because 'if possible' scopes only the box pickup, so the hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) records the task's stated order even though the environment already guarantees it; the soft Existence(target_picked_up) matches 'if possible, pick up the box' exactly.

texts: The door must be opened at least once.
The box must not be picked up before the door has been opened.
If possible, the mission box is picked up at some point.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up) -> u2
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
